products.name: Linen market tote
products.description: Washed oat linen with a flat base and leather-wrapped handles.
products.details: Holds a week of greens without slouching. Unlined, so it folds into a drawer. Spot clean. Demo SKU for the starter catalogue.

products.name: Speckled stoneware mug
products.description: A 10 oz cup with a sand foot and an iron-flecked glaze.
products.details: Dishwasher safe. The speckles are under the glaze, not paint. Pair it with the tote or leave it by the kettle.

products.name: Wool camp scarf
products.description: Undyed merino in a loose rib, long enough to wrap twice.
products.details: Light enough for a cool morning and dense enough for a drafty train. Dry flat. The third demo SKU.
